column1: # What the app knows about the loops that come with it, so that nothing has to be
# measured when it starts. One line per file in loops/, tab separated:
#   name, key, bpm, duration in ms, sample rate, channels, beats
# The key is the one the author gives (names as in the library: C, Am, G#m ...).
# A score (.mid, .gp3) has only the name and the key: tempo and length are read from
# the file, which takes milliseconds, and the key here replaces the one it declares.
# Beats is 0 for a track that is not a loop. A file that is not listed is measured.
# When a loop is changed or added, change its line, and raise BuiltIn.VERSION.
